framings.text: A human-first board and self-compounding meta harness carries work from brain dump to a PR ready for human review, while improving itself and making the codebase easier to change. You remain the restaurateur who tastes the final product.

supports.quote: a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness
its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human
that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier.
I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.

outcome: You experience a human-first board that turns a brain dump, prompt, hunch, or intuition into a durable, cohesive, verified PR ready for human review. You taste the final product, while the system compounds itself and the codebase becomes healthier and easier to change.
